claims.claim: Vietnam held funeral rites on October 14 in Ho Chi Minh City for 731 sets of war remains.
claims.episode_span: funeral rites on October 14 in Ho Chi Minh City for 731 sets of remains
claims.source_title: Vietnam mourns 700 war dead in major push to identify missing
claims.supporting_quote: The 731 sets of remains, taken from individual and mass graves of fighters killed when US-backed forces crushed an uprising by communists in 1968, were exhumed from a tree-shaded public park, according to the military.

claims.claim: Deputy mayor Nguyen Manh Cuong said most soldiers recovered in this phase could not yet be identified.
claims.episode_span: most soldiers recovered in this phase still cannot be named
claims.source_title: Vietnam mourns 700 war dead in major push to identify missing
claims.supporting_quote: “Due to the ferocity of the war and the passage of so much time, we have not yet been able to identify the names or hometowns of most of the soldiers recovered in this phase,” Cuong said.

claims.claim: Squad leader Huynh Van Quen was identified in July through a name scrap and DNA.
claims.episode_span: Huynh Van Quen, who fought in 1968, was identified in July
claims.source_title: Vietnam mourns 700 war dead in major push to identify missing
claims.supporting_quote: Quen was identified in July thanks to a scrap of paper bearing his name that was found with his remains, and DNA samples that matched his relatives.

claims.claim: The government aims to recover 7,000 sets of remains by July 2027.
claims.episode_span: recovering 7,000 sets of remains by July 2027
claims.source_title: Vietnam mourns 700 war dead in major push to identify missing
claims.supporting_quote: The government aims to recover 7,000 sets of remains by July 2027, “a political task of special importance but also a command from the heart”, according to Deputy Prime Minister Pham Thi Thanh Tra.

claims.claim: Up to 1.2 million Vietnamese soldiers are estimated to have been killed between 1945 and 1975, and there are 230,000 graves for unidentified soldiers.
claims.episode_span: 1.2 million Vietnamese soldiers are estimated to have been killed between 1945 and 1975
claims.source_title: Vietnam mourns 700 war dead in major push to identify missing
claims.supporting_quote: Up to 1.2 million Vietnamese soldiers are estimated to have been killed between 1945 and 1975, during wars involving former colonial power France, and then the United States as well as its allies.

claims.claim: A pilot pulled genetic data from 54 of 58 degraded samples.
claims.episode_span: pulled genetic data from 54 of 58 severely degraded samples
claims.source_title: Vietnam mourns 700 war dead in major push to identify missing
claims.supporting_quote: Using US-funded technology through the International Commission on Missing Persons, a pilot programme had reported genetic data was successfully pulled from 54 of 58 samples, he said.

claims.claim: A Seoul court sentenced Kang Sun-woo to two and a half years and forfeiture of 100 million won.
claims.episode_span: sentenced independent lawmaker Kang Sun-woo to two and a half years in prison
claims.source_title: Lawmaker sentenced to 2 1/2 yrs in prison over cash-for-nomination scandal
claims.supporting_quote: A Seoul district court on Wednesday sentenced independent lawmaker Kang Sun-woo to 2 1/2 years in prison on charges of receiving money in exchange for an election nomination.

claims.claim: The Sepang one-off Grand Prix generated nearly 950 million ringgit, about 232 million US dollars.
claims.episode_span: generated nearly 950 million ringgit, about 232 million US dollars
claims.source_title: F1 race at Malaysia’s Sepang generated nearly US$232 million: Sports ministry
claims.supporting_quote: The Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix held at Malaysia’s Sepang International Circuit generated nearly RM950 million (US$232 million) in economic impact, the youth and sports ministry said on Tuesday (Oct 13).

claims.claim: A recording device was found on October 11 aboard HMAS Leeuwin in Cairns.
claims.episode_span: found on October 11 in a cabin of the Navy ship HMAS Leeuwin, docked in Cairns
claims.source_title: Breaking: Recording device found in cabin of Australian navy ship
claims.supporting_quote: The device was discovered on October 11, on HMAS Leeuwin while it was docked in Cairns.

claims.claim: Treasurer Jim Chalmers ordered six investors holding about 17 per cent of Northern Minerals to divest by July 2.
claims.episode_span: ordered six investors holding around 17 per cent of Northern Minerals to divest by July 2
claims.source_title: Rare earths company could be nationalised as China-linked investors fail to divest
claims.supporting_quote: In May, federal Treasurer Jim Chalmers ordered six investors which hold around 17 per cent of Northern Minerals to divest by July 2 from the company, which is developing the Browns Range project in Western Australia's east Kimberley region.

claims.claim: Madeleine King said nationalising Northern Minerals is one option and that no decision had been made.
claims.episode_span: King said it was one option, but that she would not want to advance on any decision
claims.source_title: Rare earths company could be nationalised as China-linked investors fail to divest
claims.supporting_quote: "I guess it is one option, but I wouldn't want to advance on any decision we're making there," she said.

claims.claim: The Yorke and Northern Local Health Network began a six-month alternating birthing trial at Jamestown and Crystal Brook.
claims.episode_span: six-month trial that alternates a one-team, one-site birthing service between Jamestown and Crystal Brook
claims.source_title: Rural doctors hit out at 'unsafe' birthing services model amid shortages
claims.supporting_quote: The six-month trial by the Yorke and Northern Local Health Network (YNLHN) would entail a one-team, one-site birthing model that would alternate between the two hospitals.

claims.claim: Police rounded up 39 people for illegally trading housing subscription savings accounts.
claims.episode_span: Police have rounded up 39 people for illegally trading housing subscription savings accounts
claims.source_title: 39 rounded up for illegally trading housing subscription accounts
claims.supporting_quote: Police have rounded up 39 people for illegally trading housing subscription savings accounts, a key requirement for apartment applications, as part of an ongoing crackdown on real estate speculation, officials said Wednesday.

claims.claim: President Lee Jae Myung appointed the tax agency chief as presidential chief of staff.
claims.episode_span: appointed the head of the tax agency as his new presidential chief of staff

claims.supporting_quote: SEOUL, Oct. 14 (Yonhap) -- President Lee Jae Myung on Wednesday appointed the he...

claims.claim: Eli Remolona said Asia must guard against a repeat of the late-1990s financial crisis.
claims.episode_span: Asian countries must guard against a repeat of the late-1990s financial crisis
claims.source_title: Asia must guard against repeat of 1997 financial crisis: Philippine central bank chief
claims.supporting_quote: Asian countries must remind themselves about what happened during the region’s financial crisis in the late 1990s and guard against a recurrence of such shocks, the head of the Philippine central bank said on Wednesday.

claims.claim: Japan protested a Chinese delegation visit to an island held by Russia.
claims.episode_span: Japan has protested a Chinese delegation’s visit to an island held by Russia
claims.source_title: Japan protests Chinese delegation visit to island held by Russia
claims.supporting_quote: It's the latest indication of a growing alignment between Russia and China to pressure PM Sanae Takaichi's government.
